# Index names present in schema/<dialect>/v1.sql at release tag v1.0.0.
#
# This is a frozen historical record, not a list to keep current: it names
# what a database created by v1.0.0 already has, so the migration-coverage
# test can compute which indexes a pre-existing database is missing and
# require a MIGRATIONS.md statement for each. Editing it to match a newer
# schema would silence exactly the check it feeds. It changes only if the
# v1.0.0 tag is re-cut, which cannot happen.
#
# Verify (never update) with:
#   git show v1.0.0:op/storeadapter/sql/schema/<dialect>/v1.sql
#
# Format: <dialect> <index name>, sorted.
sqlite idx_oidc_access_tokens_grant
sqlite idx_oidc_ciba_requests_expires
sqlite idx_oidc_device_codes_expires
sqlite idx_oidc_email_otps_retain
sqlite idx_oidc_grant_revocations_expires
sqlite idx_oidc_grants_sub_client
sqlite idx_oidc_opaque_access_tokens_expires
sqlite idx_oidc_opaque_access_tokens_grant
sqlite idx_oidc_passkeys_subject
sqlite idx_oidc_refresh_tokens_grant
sqlite idx_oidc_refresh_tokens_parent
sqlite idx_oidc_revoked_jtis_expires
sqlite idx_oidc_sessions_chooser
sqlite oidc_device_codes_user_code
sqlite oidc_users_username
